units.characteristics: the rebellious, sick interior; the offer to reason and be made clean
units.gist: GEM - 'the ox knows its owner... but Israel does not know'; 'the whole head is sick, the whole heart faint'; the wearying of empty worship ('your appointed feasts my soul hates'); 'wash yourselves, cease to do evil, learn to do good'; 'COME, let us REASON together: though your sins are like scarlet, they shall be as white as snow' - the estranged heart summoned back and offered cleansing

units.characteristics: the corrupted city; purging judgment that restores
units.gist: 'how the faithful city has become a whore... your silver has become dross'; the LORD will 'smelt away your dross' and 'restore your judges'; 'Zion shall be REDEEMED by justice, and those in her who repent by righteousness' - fidelity corroded, judgment as refining, restoration through repentance

units.characteristics: the taught, walked way of the LORD; the resolve to walk in his light
units.gist: the mountain of the LORD in the latter days; 'that he may TEACH us his ways and we may WALK in his paths'; swords into plowshares; 'O house of Jacob, come, let us WALK in the light of the LORD' - the interior drawn to be taught and to walk God's way

units.characteristics: the humbling of human pride; the LORD alone exalted
units.gist: GEM - 'the haughty LOOKS of man shall be brought low, the lofty PRIDE of men humbled, and the LORD alone exalted'; the day of the LORD against all that is proud/lifted-up; idols cast to moles and bats; 'STOP REGARDING MAN in whose nostrils is breath, for of what account is he?' - self-exaltation levelled, trust in man renounced

units.characteristics: the self-exposing face of sin; leaders who devour the poor
units.gist: support removed from Jerusalem; 'the LOOK on their faces bears witness against them; they proclaim their sin like Sodom, they do not hide it'; the LORD contends: 'it is you who have devoured the vineyard... grinding the FACE of the poor' - sin worn openly on the face; power that consumes the weak

units.characteristics: haughty vanity stripped; the cleansed remnant made holy
units.gist: the 'HAUGHTY daughters of Zion' with outstretched necks and wanton glances, their finery stripped to sackcloth and shame; then (4:2-6) the branch of the LORD, the survivor 'called HOLY', 'when the Lord shall have WASHED away the filth... by a spirit of judgment and burning' - vanity humbled; the remnant cleansed and canopied

units.characteristics: love's disappointed labour; looking for justice, finding bloodshed
units.gist: GEM - the song of the beloved's vineyard: dug, cleared, planted with choice vines, 'he LOOKED for it to yield grapes, but it yielded WILD grapes'; 'he looked for JUSTICE, but behold BLOODSHED; for righteousness, but an OUTCRY' - tended love met by the wild fruit of an unresponsive heart

units.characteristics: the six woes: greed, self-inflaming appetite, defiant sin, inverted values, self-wisdom
units.gist: GEM - six woes anatomising the corrupt interior: joining house to house (insatiable acquisition); running after drink, no regard for the LORD's deeds; drawing sin 'with cords of falsehood', daring God to hurry; 'WOE to those who call EVIL GOOD and good evil'; 'woe to those WISE IN THEIR OWN EYES'; the acquitting of the guilty for a bribe - the whole grammar of a self-justifying, value-inverted heart

units.characteristics: the undone self before holiness; cleansed lips; the volunteered 'here am I'
units.gist: THE GEM - 'Holy, holy, holy is the LORD of hosts'; 'WOE IS ME! for I am LOST; for I am a man of UNCLEAN LIPS... my eyes have seen the King'; the burning coal - 'your guilt is taken away, your sin atoned for'; 'Whom shall I send?' - 'HERE AM I! SEND ME' - the self undone by holiness, cleansed, then freely offered; and the hardening commission ('make the heart of this people dull')

units.characteristics: the shaking heart; faith as the condition of standing; 'God with us'
units.gist: GEM - Ahaz's 'heart SHOOK as the trees shake before the wind'; the word 'be careful, be QUIET, do not FEAR... do not let your heart be faint'; 'IF YOU ARE NOT FIRM IN FAITH, YOU WILL NOT BE FIRM AT ALL'; Ahaz refusing to ask the sign under false piety; the sign of IMMANUEL, 'God with us' - fear vs faith as the ground of standing

units.characteristics: whom to fear; the sanctuary vs the stone of stumbling; waiting for the hiding God
units.gist: GEM - against the plots of the nations, 'God is with us'; 'do not FEAR what they fear, nor be in dread. But the LORD of hosts, HIM you shall honour as holy; let HIM be your FEAR' - fear relocated from the world to God; 'I will WAIT for the LORD, who is HIDING his face... and I will HOPE in him'; inquire of God not the dead - the interior's fear, waiting, and hope rightly directed

units.characteristics: light in deep darkness; joy multiplied; the child who is Prince of Peace
units.gist: GEM - 'the people who walked in DARKNESS have seen a great LIGHT'; 'you have multiplied the nation, increased its JOY... they rejoice before you'; 'to us a CHILD is born... Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, PRINCE OF PEACE' - the interior lifted from darkness to joy by the given child; peace and government without end

units.characteristics: the proud, unrepentant heart; the anger not turned away
units.gist: 'all the people will know... who say in PRIDE and in ARROGANCE OF HEART: the bricks have fallen but we will build with dressed stones'; 'the people did NOT TURN to him who struck them, nor inquire of the LORD'; the refrain 'for all this his anger has not turned away, and his hand is stretched out still'; woe to unjust decree-makers - pride that will not turn even under the blow

units.characteristics: the boasting instrument; the axe vaunting over the hand; the remnant that leans on the LORD
units.gist: GEM - Assyria 'the ROD of my anger', but 'he does not so INTEND; it is in his HEART to destroy'; 'BY THE STRENGTH OF MY HAND I have done it, and by my wisdom'; 'shall the AXE BOAST over him who hews with it?' - the creature vaunting its self-derived power; then the remnant 'will LEAN on the LORD, the Holy One, in TRUTH' - misplaced self-confidence exposed, dependence relocated to God

units.characteristics: the Spirit-rested ruler; delight in the fear of the LORD; the peace of full knowledge
units.gist: GEM - 'a shoot from the stump of Jesse... the Spirit of the LORD shall REST upon him, the Spirit of wisdom and understanding, counsel and might, knowledge and the FEAR OF THE LORD; and his DELIGHT shall be in the fear of the LORD'; the wolf with the lamb; 'the earth shall be FULL of the KNOWLEDGE of the LORD as the waters cover the sea' - the ideal interior (Spirit-endowed, delighting in God's fear) and the peace that flows from knowing God

units.characteristics: trust that dissolves fear; joy drawing from the wells of salvation
units.gist: THE GEM - 'I will give thanks to you, O LORD, for though you were ANGRY with me, your anger TURNED AWAY, that you might COMFORT me'; 'God is my salvation; I will TRUST, and will NOT BE AFRAID; for the LORD is my STRENGTH and my SONG'; 'with JOY you will draw water from the WELLS OF SALVATION' - the redeemed interior: trust displacing fear, God himself as strength/song, joy at the spring
